value: In the Red Sea of old an image of the Bride who knew not wedlock was depicted. There Moses was the one who parted the sea, here Gabriel is the minister of the miracle. At that time Israel marched dry-shod through the deep, now the Virgin doth seedlessly give birth to Christ. The sea after Israel's passage remained impassable; the Immaculate one after bearing Emmanuel remained incorrupt. O God, who doth exist and is pre-eternal, and hath appeared as man, have mercy upon us.
